data.Name: The Goose King Cometh
data.Description: The legendary Goose King has emerged from the marshlands to terrorize the countryside. Honk.
data.Template_Text: BREAKING NEWS: [Enemy1], the dreaded Goose King, has waddled forth from the swamps near [Location1] to wreak feathery havoc upon the land! [NPC1] begs for help — the geese have stolen everyone's bread, overturned every cart, and honked at children until they cried. This fowl menace must be stopped!

data.2nd_state_Template_Text: You have vanquished [Enemy1], the Goose King, near [Location1]. [NPC1] weeps with joy. Feathers drift on the breeze like confetti. But wait — a shadow falls across the land. A single, ominous honk pierces the silence. The Goose Prince is coming for revenge.
